info.name: Agonito API - Complete
info.description:
Complete collection generated from routes/api.php and all included API route files. Contains 55 requests covering every allowed API method, plus one CSRF setup utility request.

Quick start: set base_url, run Authentication/Send OTP and Verify OTP, then use protected requests. For Promo Checkout, run Setup/Get CSRF Cookie first and preserve cookies.

item.name: Get CSRF Cookie (required for Promo Checkout)

request.description: Utility route (outside routes/api.php). Run once before promo checkout requests. Postman keeps the session and XSRF cookies automatically.

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: OTP authentication. Run Send OTP, Verify OTP, then authenticated requests.

request.description: Public. Bangladesh mobile format: 01XXXXXXXXX. Throttled to 5 requests/minute.
Public. Call after Send OTP and observe the resend cooldown.
Public. Stores the returned Sanctum token in the collection token variable.

request.description: Session-based. Run Setup/Get CSRF Cookie first and keep Postman cookies enabled.

Requires a verified promo OTP in the same session.
